text.p: Shares in leading Estonian bank Hansapank maintained their rally on Wednesday, rising a further five kroons to 133 kroons in late trade on a large volume of 30 million kroons, dealers said.
The rally was sparked yesterday after the bank said that its shares were now being quoted on the Frankfurt stock exchange.
The share trade was helped today by a block trade of 110,000 shares.
"It was like mass psychosis, everybody is buying Hansapank," said Riho Talumaa, a dealer from investment house Talinvest.
He said the market might however become calmer before Christmas.
One foreign broker said that the share trade was being boosted by expectations of positive profit figures for Hansapank next year.
